newsitem.title: INDIA: India tribal guerrillas kill 3 policemen in ambush.
newsitem.headline: India tribal guerrillas kill 3 policemen in ambush.

text.p: Kuki tribal guerrillas killed three policemen and wounded four in an ambush in the northeastern state of Manipur on Sunday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The incident took place in a village on National Highway 39 in the Senapati district of the state near the Burmese border.
Police stepped up patrols on the highway this week after 30 Kuki bus passengers were massacred by rival Naga tribesmen in the neighbouring state of Nagaland on Monday.
The two tribes have been fighting to control the strategic highway which authorities say they use to smuggle drugs from Burma to Europe. The separatist Nagas see the Kukis as pro-India.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in the rivalry that began in mid-1992.
